lines.displayLine: Detective Müller! Galesville welcomes you with open arms! Sorry you have to see the town in this sorry state. I assure you this is an extremely atypical pickle we’ve found ourselves in here.
Pleased to meet you, Mayor Rockwell. I’ve heard a lot about Galesville from my debrief with the captain earlier this week.

Well I’ll be damned. When they said Chicago was gonna send her finest, I didn’t expect them to send a her! Listen, lady, this isn’t some two timed co-ed city caper. Try not to stand in my way. If you’d like, maybe you can file the paperwork.
I.. uh… While I understand your hesitation towards my abilities, Sheriff. I assure you I’m perfectly capable of conducting a clean investigation.
Hey, hey now, we’re all on the same side. At the end of the day we all play for the same team … America.
Anyways, Nurse O’Bannon, would you kindly tell us about the body we’ve all gathered here to see.
Please follow me, while I inform you of my findings.
Good golly I’ve never seen anything like this in my life.
We have not either and believe us. The things that you see nowadays in this town are a little questionable.

There is this mysterious substance all over him and it looks like it’s making him decompose faster than other corpses I’ve examined before. You can see the abnormal bite marks in his flesh, and his organs are completely visible. Lastly, his left arm and leg were amputated and were nowhere to be found at the scene of the crime.
Ms. O’Bannon when did this occur exactly?
Well Miss detective, this occurred on Sunday, around the afternoon.
Understood, would you happen to know the location the body was found?

I actually took a picture of the scene, but the clutz that I am I left it at the Police Station. You’ll have to stop by if you want to take a look. That is, if you have the time. I’m sure you’ll be SO busy with getting to the bottom of this.
Do we have any sort of idea of motive? I know it's a little early to tell, but I need to start somewhere. I should ask if anyone's seen anything odd?
